events.title: Hotfix 2 - 0.9.6

events.title: Patch note - Demo build V0.9.5
events.summary: Dear Citadel Explorers, today is a new day for The Citadel Project. Kind of a "big update" for the demo. Improved movements, reworked climb system, reworked rope behavior, parry feature, lot of bug fixing, total in game time displayed at the end of the level, reworked fall damage formula, ... I hope you'll enjoy ! Indeed, there is still issues that I'm currently fixing, and new one that will be discovered soon enough, but don't worry I'm on it.
